title: Zero Points in Paris
narrativeQuestion: How did an athlete who received zero votes become the most famous competitor of Paris 2024, and what was true about the outrage?

chapters.title: Zero Points in Paris
chapters.claim: Raygun lost three battles on August 9, 2024 and received 0 of 54 judge votes.

chapters.title: From a Bronx Rec Room to the Olympics
chapters.claim: Breaking traces to a 1973 Bronx party, reached the Youth Olympics in 2018 and Paris 2024, and was left off LA 2028 in October 2023.

chapters.title: Nine Judges, Two Rounds
chapters.claim: Nine judges vote each round on five criteria, so a group battle is decided out of 18 votes.

chapters.title: How a Lecturer Got to Paris
chapters.claim: Gunn qualified legitimately by winning the October 2023 Oceania championship under the continental quota system.

chapters.title: Rumor or Record?
chapters.claim: The petition's claims about rigged selection were false according to the Australian Olympic Committee.

chapters.title: Number One, Then Gone
chapters.claim: She was ranked first in September 2024, retired in November 2024 and told her story in a 2026 Netflix documentary.

accuracyNotes: The first battle clip is a fan upload of the broadcast and may disappear from YouTube.
Petition claims are paraphrased from the AOC's published list of facts.
